title: myriachaeta arundinacea
intro: Myriachaeta arundinacea, commonly known as  Elephant's tooth or  Siam rubwood, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Myriachaeta arundinacea include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body from infection and disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
